unreal.html:
Unreal Engine shipped

Unreal Engine 5.8 with a C++ toolchain (Xcode on macOS, Visual Studio 2022 on Windows). Source plug-in; the editor compiles it on first open.

Download for Unreal
v3.0.0-beta.1 · 3.0 MB · VersePublish-UE5.8-3.0.0-beta.1.zip
SHA-25632385ecc8f96b71d04034f940b497a10432e5e680926727881e33c36a5a49ea3
  1. Close the editor and unzip into your project, so you have <Project>/Plugins/VersePublish/VersePublish.uplugin.The Plugins folder sits next to your .uproject.
  2. Open the project and accept the prompt to rebuild the module.A Tools › Verse menu appears.
  3. Optional: paste an account token from Studio in Project Settings › Plugins › Verse Publish.Your scenes become permanent and are listed in your library.
  4. Open Tools › Verse › Publish to Verse and press Publish to Verse.Upload %, then the build stages, then the link — copied for you.

What gets published

  • The level (or the selected actors) as one scene
  • Unreal materials and lighting, baked on publish
  • Textures at source resolution — nothing downscaled

Big projects

Up to 20 GB, sent in resumable parts. Browser uploads stop at 500 MB.

Full guide: Publish from Unreal →

unity.html:
Unity shipped

Unity 2021.3 or newer (URP, HDRP, Built-in). UPM tarball; glTFast is pulled in for you.

Download for Unity
v3.0.0-beta.1 · 3.0 MB · com.ctruh.verse-publish-3.0.0-beta.1.tgz
SHA-25624741c9d4736784af4ed7ac9240d928d90d6cefd8c773a92dfc48df55a4d8505
  1. Download the .tgz and keep it somewhere stable — your project's Packages/ folder is ideal.Unity references the file by path.
  2. Window › Package Manager › + › Add package from tarball… and pick it.The install finishes with no console errors.
  3. Open Tools › Verse › Publish Scene; optionally paste an account token from Studio.The window remembers it.
  4. Press Publish scene.Upload %, then the build stages, then the link — copied for you.

What gets published

  • The open scene (or the selection) as one scene
  • Lighting baked on publish; the skybox as the background
  • Terrain as tile meshes, LOD0 of every LOD group
  • Textures at source resolution — nothing downscaled

Big projects

Up to 20 GB, sent in resumable parts. Browser uploads stop at 500 MB.

Full guide: Publish from Unity →

blender.html:
Blender shipped

Blender 4.2 or newer. Extension zip; also installs as a legacy add-on.

Download for Blender
v3.0.0-beta.1 · 3.0 MB · verse_publish-blender-3.0.0-beta.1.zip
SHA-2562ff2dd7074cf3073b0e68e78af5ee2dcb6047b701824a84e8823930f0ba4f545
  1. Download the zip — don't unzip it.One file; Blender installs it as it is.
  2. Edit › Preferences › Get Extensions, open the ⌄ menu, choose Install from Disk… and pick the zip (or drag it onto Blender)."Verse Publish" is listed and enabled — no restart.
  3. Optional: paste an account token from Studio in Preferences › Add-ons › Verse Publish.Your scenes become permanent and are listed in your library.
  4. Press N in the 3D viewport, open the Verse tab and click Publish scene.Export, optimise, upload, build — then the link is on your clipboard.

What gets published

  • The scene (or the selected objects), modifiers applied
  • Node materials — and at High your lighting — baked on publish
  • Textures at source resolution, right-sized to what the scene can show

Big projects

Up to 20 GB, sent in resumable parts. Browser uploads stop at 500 MB.

Full guide: Publish from Blender →

Revit 2021–2024 and 2025+ (Windows). Add-in zip with both builds.
